headline: BIGBANG reunite at MAMA, debut new song 'GiiiRIP'
sub: Named Music Visionary of the Year in their 20th year
source: Source: Joy News 24, TenAsia, SPOTV News
caption:
BIGBANG took the stage together at the 2026 MAMA AWARDS and debuted their new song 'GiiiRIP'.

Marking their 20th debut anniversary, the 3-member group performed 'BiiiG', a time-travel medley of their hits, and the first-ever stage of 'GiiiRIP' at Kyocera Dome Osaka on Nov 21. They were named Music Visionary of the Year and also won Best Music Video for 'BiiiG'. G-Dragon joked, "It's been a while since the three of us stood together, so it took a bit to find our spots."
